# Practice Tests Exams Platform

> Open source web app for practising IT certification exams, including AWS, Azure, GCP, ITIL, Scrum, and more.

The Practice Tests Exams Platform at https://education.ditectrev.com is developed by Ditectrev's community. It offers untimed practice mode and timed exam mode, progress tracking, and optional AI-powered explanations (Ollama locally, or OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Ditectrev-hosted models).

Ditectrev is an IT company focused on consulting and online education. It is registered in Poland as IBStructure Daniel Danielecki, Irysowa 18, 55-220 Jelcz-Laskowice, tax ID PL9121899240. Contact: contact@ditectrev.com, +48 732 280 741.

Question sets come from Ditectrev community repositories. A free trial is available; subscriptions remove ads and unlock explanation tiers. Do not invent ratings, review scores, headcount, or pass-rate claims.

For a longer citation-friendly fact sheet and Q&A, see [llms-full.txt](https://education.ditectrev.com/llms-full.txt).
